dedupe_keys.name: datasets of meteorological drought events and risks for the developing countries in eurasia

description: Hua, Zhong and Yan publish drought-event and risk datasets for developing countries across Eurasia. Science Data Bank describes gridded meteorological events from 1950 to 2015 based on three drought indices, followed by country-level risk estimates for 2000 to 2015 that combine hazard with exposure and vulnerability indicators. The public repository page identifies 107 files totalling 3.34 GB and CC0 rights; the article says the files are in MATLAB format. Metadata can be read without charge or sign-in. The exact grid size and file-level temporal frequency were not established without opening the files. Water-supply, irrigation and reservoir simulations could use these historical events to select drought scenarios or compare regional risk, after matching units and locations to asset data. The risk scores include social and infrastructural factors but do not model a specific utility network or future climate. The article prints a malformed DOI URL; the valid DOI resolves to the named Science Data Bank page. No files were downloaded or run.
